name: Karamat Ali Jaunpuri
contribution: Karamat Ali Jaunpuri was a nineteenth-century Islamic preacher and reformist associated with the Tariqah-i-Muhammadiya current.
context: His preaching travelled through Bengal and North India amid debates about religious authority, rural practice, and Muslim reform under colonial rule.
impact: He connects Bengal’s local religious debates to wider reform networks rooted in the Waliullahi tradition.
highlight: A bridge between Bengal's Muslim reform debates and North Indian revivalist networks.
seoTitle: Karamat Ali Jaunpuri: Islamic Reform and Debate in Bengal
seoDescription: Learn about Karamat Ali Jaunpuri’s preaching, reformist debates, and connections between Muslim public life in Bengal and wider North Indian networks.
shortAnswer: Karamat Ali Jaunpuri was an Islamic preacher whose nineteenth-century reformist work connected Bengal with wider South Asian religious debates.
